title: VideoProcessingFailed
description: From the media worker (queue: media-results): processing stopped for good. Sent for non-retryable media errors, or after transient retries are exhausted.

code.description: e.g. SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_A_VIDEO, NO_VIDEO_STREAM, UNSUPPORTED_CODEC, DURATION_TOO_LONG, RESOLUTION_OUT_OF_RANGE, CORRUPT_SOURCE, ENCODER_FAILED, RETRIES_EXHAUSTED. New codes may be added; consumers must handle unknown ones.

message.description: For logs and the admin console. Not shown to creators verbatim.

retryable.description: true when retrying the same source could succeed (e.g. after a worker fix).
